pages.text: The hound that guards the gates of Hel in the mists of Niflheim. His howl brings darkness and slows you, his bite weakens and freezes.
How to beat: bring milk against the darkness and fight near walls where he cannot charge. Drops Garm's fang.
The hound of the cold mists dreads fire: while Garm burns, every blow hurts him twice as much. Bring a Fire Aspect sword or flaming arrows.
